summary: Every REQUIRED scalar body flag is serialized when it was passed (cmd.Flags().Changed), whatever its zero value ("", 0, 0.0, false), on every generated command: 297 guards in 165 files (294 written by the codemod, 3 by hand: emails create-template --body/--channel/--name). A complete regeneration shows exactly 297 `// PATCH(reprint-637-required-on-changed)` serializer guards across 165 non-test files under internal/cli/; fewer means the codemod or the hand guards were not re-applied. Required = the generator's own `required flag` check list plus the body params tools-manifest.json marks required (a required param with a spec default gets no check, e.g. booking-pages create --duration-minutes). Applied by the post-print codemod .printing-press-patches/required-on-changed.pl (run from the repo root after every reprint: `perl .printing-press-patches/required-on-changed.pl internal/cli/*.go`; idempotent). Replaces the r2 per-flag entry reprint-637-required-zero-values (its seven guards are the same rule, now under this marker). Query flags and optional flags keep the generator's guard. Round 5 (Codex reprint637-r4): the codemod also rewrites the required whole-body --body-json (flagBodyJSON) of the seven anyOf/oneOf commands (ai post-tasks, automations post-validate, batch-operations post, chat post-agents-me-inbox-ack/-claim, conduyt-auth post-signup-events, emails create-template): an empty value is a local parse error instead of a silent {}; emails create-template's hand-shaped required set --body/--channel/--name is serialized on Changed() by hand (same marker); conduyt-auth register refuses an explicit --terms-accepted=false under --dry-run too. Reprint gocli1219 (Printing Press 4.34.2): the press now serializes every body flag on `cmd.Flags().Changed("<flag>") || <non-zero>`, so the scalar rule is absorbed upstream and the 292 codemod guards are gone from generated files. The codemod stays the re-runnable post-print step: on 4.34.2 output it rewrites only the seven required whole-body --body-json guards (`required-on-changed: 7 guards in 7 files`). The true count after gocli1219 is 20 `// PATCH(reprint-637-required-on-changed)` markers in 12 non-test files: 7 codemod (--body-json) + 13 in hand-kept files (emails create-template --body/--channel/--name 3, conduyt-auth register 4, users invite 2, conduyt-auth logout 2, screen-share delete-session-code 1, calls link call-to-contact 1). TestEveryRequiredBodyFlagSerializesItsZeroValue still walks every required scalar body param (245) and now runs as the dogfood harness (4.34.2 enforces the other required flags under a user's --dry-run); the two multipart file paths are no longer exceptions (the 4.34.2 dry-run preview opens no file).
reason: Printing Press 4.28.0 guards every scalar body field with `!= ""` / `!= 0` / `!= 0.0`, so a required flag passed with its zero value passed the required check and was then dropped from the body; Codex found the class three rounds running (reprint637-r2 --folders=0, r3 --tag-prefix "" and --price 0). The template is upstream (the press pinned at 4.28.0), so the rule lives in a codemod the reprint recipe runs, pinned by a manifest-wide test.
validated_outcome: TestEveryRequiredBodyFlagSerializesItsZeroValue walks tools-manifest.json (every tool x required scalar body param, 242 checked, 8 documented exceptions that refuse their zero value on purpose: register --terms-accepted, decide-contact --decision, email send's hand-written set, the two multipart file paths) and asserts the dry-run body with the zero-valued flag differs from the body without it; 214 failures before the codemod, 0 after. Fails if the walk checks fewer than 200 params. Round 5: the walk includes DELETE bodies (245 checked, incl. contacts collaborators --user-id-2 and screen-share --marks-drew/--marks-pointed); every documented exception must refuse its zero value under --dry-run; TestRequiredFlagsOutsideTheManifestWalk covers the seven --body-json commands and the create-template set (all fail at 80c843e).
upstream_issue: For the press board (not filed): serialize a required body field on Changed(), not on a non-zero value.
